notes: The operator identifies a configurable private proving ground. This exact independent source-node route retains complementary northern and southern inner connections. Its real shared junctions and source way versions are preserved. It complements the long variant to represent the supplied branch configuration without implying that the entire branch set is a single lap. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 53 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

refinement.note: Five visible dark-pavement/grass transitions on the building-side straight replace false detections at the far side of the grass strip. Two seed endpoints join this local correction to the automatic estimate. The adjoining wide test pads and lane junctions remain provisional automatic surface limits; other sections retain unverified estimates. No preferred track width or curb placement is supplied.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. Sparse edge anchors measured on the pinned image correct the documented sections. Evidence scores describe the original automatic proposal, not the corrected borders. The seed and final border hashes and correction recipe are retained.
